days.title: 짱안 – 바이딘
days.morning: Take the Trang An boat trip through water caves (2–3 hours).
days.afternoon: Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda, lunch on crispy rice and mountain goat.
days.evening: Stay at a homestay in Tam Coc among the rice fields.

days.title: 땀꼭 – 무아 동굴
days.morning: Cycle the countryside and take the Tam Coc – Bich Dong boat.
days.afternoon: Visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and the temples of kings Dinh and Le.
days.evening: Climb 500 steps of Mua Cave for sunset.

days.title: 반롱 – 새 공원
days.morning: Boat through Van Long reserve to spot Delacour's langurs.
days.afternoon: Thung Nham bird park, where thousands of egrets return at dusk.
days.evening: Try mountain snails and sắng greens.

days.title: 팟지엠 대성당
days.morning: Phat Diem stone cathedral – a unique blend of Vietnamese and European architecture.
days.afternoon: Kim Son beach or the sedge-weaving village.
days.evening: Back to Tam Coc and its evening streets.

days.title: 꾹프엉 숲
days.morning: Cuc Phuong National Park – primate rescue centre and a thousand-year-old tree.
days.afternoon: Cave of Prehistoric Man and Con Moong cave.
days.evening: Try raw fish salad and crispy rice with pork floss.
